lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere jan dhiaavahi ik man ik chit te saadhoo sukh paavahi jap har har naam nidhaan ||
lines.translation: Your humble servants focus their consciousness and meditate on You with one-pointed mind; those Holy beings find peace, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Treasure of Bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: usatat karahi prabh tereeaa mil saadhoo saadh janaa gur satiguroo bhagavaan ||1||
lines.translation: They sing Your Praises, God, meeting with the Holy, the Holy people, and the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਤਰੇ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਤੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai hiradai too suaamee te sukh phal paavahi te tare bhav si(n)dh te bhagat har jaan ||
lines.translation: They alone obtain the fruit of peace, within whose hearts You, O my Lord and Master, abide. They cross over the terrifying world-ocean - they are known as the Lord's devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਮ ਲਾਇ ਹਰੇ ਹਮ ਲਾਇ ਹਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: tin sevaa ham laai hare ham laai hare jan naanak ke har too too too too too bhagavaan ||2||6||12||
lines.translation: Please enjoin me to their service, Lord, please enjoin me to their service. O Lord God, You, You, You, You, You are the Lord of servant Nanak. ||2||6||12||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, the Treasure of Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh bidaaran sukhadaate satigur jaa kau bhetat hoi sagal sidh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of peace; meeting Him, one is totally fulfilled. ||1||Pause||
Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Support of the mind.
Millions of sinners are carried across in an instant. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau cheet aavai gur apanaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever remembers his Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa kau dookh nahee til supanaa ||2||
lines.translation: shall not suffer sorrow, even in dreams. ||2||
Whoever keeps his Guru enshrined within

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: so jan har ras rasanaa chaakhai ||3||
lines.translation: - that humble being tastes the sublime essence of the Lord with his tongue. ||3||
Says Nanak, the Guru has been Kind to me;
here and herafter, my face is radiant. ||4||1||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
I worship and adore You, my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat saas saas saas har japane ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, with each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within the hearts of those,
whose Lord and Master blesses them with this gift. ||1||
Peace and tranquility come into the hearts of those
who meet their Lord and Master, through the Word of the Guru. ||2||
Those whom the Guru blesses with the Mantra of the Naam

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam ma(n)tr jaa kau gur deen ||3||
lines.translation: are wise, and blessed with all powers. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak taa kai bal jaau ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those
who are blessed with the Name in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||4||2||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਾਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਸਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: keerat prabh kee gaau meree rasanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Sing the Praises of God, O my tongue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਊਹਾਂ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik baar kar ba(n)dan sa(n)tan oohaa(n) charan gobi(n)d jee ke basanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Humbly bow to the Saints, over and over again; through them, the Feet of the Lord of the Universe shall come to abide within you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik bhaa(n)t kar duaar na paavau ||
lines.translation: The Door to the Lord cannot be found by any other means.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hoi kripaal ta har har dhiaavau ||1||
lines.translation: When He becomes Merciful, we come to meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot karam kar deh na sodhaa ||
lines.translation: The body is not purified by millions of rituals.
The mind is awakened and enlightened only in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisan na boojhee bahu ra(n)g maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Thirst and desire are not quenched by enjoying the many pleasures of Maya.
Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is found. ||3||
When the Supreme Lord God becomes Merciful,
says Nanak, then one is rid of worldly entanglements. ||4||3||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
Beg for such blessings from the Lord of the Universe:

lines.gurmukhi: ਟਹਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਜਪਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tahal sa(n)tan kee sa(n)g saadhoo kaa har naamaa(n) jap param gate ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: to work for the Saints, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Chanting the Name of the Lord, the supreme status is obtained. ||1||Pause||
Worship the Feet of Your Lord and Master, and seek His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: soee kusal j prabh jeeu karanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Take joy in whatever God does. ||1||
This precious human body becomes fruitful,
